Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+4' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) replaces Lucas Da Cunha.
88' Jayden Addai (Como) is booked.
87' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.
87' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:18.

86' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
85' Ivan Smolcic comes off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Posch (Como).
84' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
84' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
83' The game is interrupted. Diego Carlos (Como) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
82' Handball by Jayden Addai (Como).
81' It's a nice effort by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Jean Butez. Easy save.
80' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
79' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

78' The resulting free kick from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Jean Butez. What a save!
76' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul after Maxence Caqueret (Como) hacks down one of his opponents. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Kamaldeen Sulemana.
74' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Ederson and he is replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
73' That's the end of the game for Ademola Lookman, who is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).
73' Jayden Addai (Como) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
72' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is equal to it and makes an easy save.
71' Nico Paz (Como) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Maxence Caqueret, but Marco Carnesecchi displays great awareness to stop him.
69' Dani Guindos prepares a substitution. Martin Baturina is replaced by Maxence Caqueret (Como).
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Alex Valle (Como) is replacing Mergim Vojvoda.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:11. 4:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
66' What a great touch by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
63' The corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared away by the defence.

63' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' The game has come to an end for Lazar Samardzic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
61' Ederson (Atalanta) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
58' This is a yellow card! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
57' Nico Paz (Como) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
55' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle as Jayden Addai (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
52' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) swings it in and Ademola Lookman gets on the end of it, but Jean Butez shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

51' Jacobo Ramon (Como) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
50' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.
49' That's unlucky! Nico Paz (Como) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
49' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

48' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The resulting corner from Martin Baturina (Como) is cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Dani Guindos decided to make a change. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is replaced by Alvaro Morata.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
44' Atalanta hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
43' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jean Butez is quickest to intercept the ball.
42' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Nico Paz (Como) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
39' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' A lofted cross from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
36' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

34' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
32' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends the corner into the box, but Jean Butez intercepts it and averts the threat.
32' 5:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.

30' Great solo effort by Jayden Addai (Como) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
29' Lazar Samardzic rounds off a good move with a layoff to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
28' Diego Carlos (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
28' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Martin Baturina (Como) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
24' A pass by Mergim Vojvoda (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
21' Ball possession – 35:65.
19' Goal-line technology proves its worth as ref immediately confirms the ball crossed the line!

19' 1 - 1 Maximo Perrone (Como) picks up a rebound just outside the box, steadies himself and unleashes a cracker that deflects off the left post into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper.

17' What a chance! Jacobo Ramon (Como) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
17' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

16' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Da Cunha (Como) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Now Como have a corner.
16' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

16' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
13' Ederson (Atalanta) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Jean Butez.
13' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
12' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
11' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Luca Zufferli signals a set piece.
10' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atalanta.
10' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
8' Ivan Smolcic (Como) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Carnesecchi punches the ball away.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
5' The Como players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Anastasios Douvikas (Como) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
2' A pass from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
